notes:
What's new in 0.1.103:
- Phone setup is one screen that shows what was really checked. Relay is only switched on by your own choice, and a renewed Relay licence reconnects with careful retries.
- Web player: skip intros automatically (per viewer), better subtitles, Space and F anywhere, and phone and TV-browser layouts that fit.
- Home: Customize layout and Layout Share carry more of your layout. Continue watching and Surprise me keep real positions.
- Audiobooks: speed saved at once, Reset to 1x, bookmarks can be deleted with undo.
- Library: a film is never also listed as a one-episode show, and moving or renaming your videos is tested not to replace a file.
- Sharing (in development): 8-character guest codes and a guest-only browser. Household members see each other's requests.
- A child profile whose limits cannot be read gets "try again" instead of being deleted.
- Not fixed: the Samsung S9+ Trip export was still at 0% in the last test. Beebo Auto is not in this release.
- Not yet checked: only automated tests and reviews. Not tried by a person on an installed app, a TV browser or a real phone.
- Release source commit 618d0403c.
- Built: Oct 27, 2026, 8:56 AM Eastern.
- Published: Oct 27, 2026, 9:06 AM Eastern.
